promo-sponsor-maths.title: The sponsorship pricing formula #shorts
promo-sponsor-maths.description: (delivered views / 1,000) x CPM x format multiplier. Most creators sit around $15-$25 CPM; a dedicated video is 1.3-1.5x, a 90-second integration 0.7-0.9x, a Short about half. And the multiplier nobody mentions: where your audience lives moves that number by two to three times, for the exact same views in the exact same niche. Full media kit tutorial on the channel.

promo-not-subscribers.title: Sponsors are not buying your subscribers #shorts
promo-not-subscribers.description: They are buying delivered views - how many humans will actually see the thing they paid for. A channel with 100,000 subscribers getting 2,000 views a video is worth less to a sponsor than one with 8,000 subscribers getting 5,000, and the second one usually charges less because the subscriber number embarrassed them. Full media kit tutorial on the channel.
